name: common_gate_resource_upper_construction
explanation: Exact matrix verification includes phases, not only classical truth tables. Fredkin(c,a,b) is chronological CX(b,a), CCX(c,a,b), CX(b,a). A six-CNOT ancilla-free Toffoli gives eight CNOTs per Fredkin. Two controlled global SWAPs on two-qubit registers use four Fredkins, hence 32 CNOTs; four extra weight-two Pauli rotations add eight. This is a constructive upper bound, not an optimal compiled count.

resource_counts.assumptions: All-to-all logical CNOT availability; arbitrary required single-qubit rotations; no routing, error correction, state preparation, readout, cancellation optimization, or additional unlisted layers are counted. Four Pauli rotations are an explicit module assumption.
resource_counts.not_claimed: An optimal count, a lower bound, equality with a generic QNN gate budget, or a hardware-level runtime comparison.
